# application of the Contrast workflow | file under example/ that its SBoB replaces
# an application that is not listed goes to example/contrast/<application>/cp-<application>.yaml

php2shell|example/php2shell/sbobs/cp-php2shell.yaml
php2shell-wordpress|example/php2shell-wordpress/sbobs/cp-wordpress.yaml
flux-source|example/flux/deploy/flux-source-manager.yaml
flux-kustomize|example/flux/deploy/flux-kustomize-manager.yaml
flux-helm|example/flux/deploy/flux-helm-manager.yaml
flux-notification|example/flux/deploy/flux-notification-manager.yaml
flux-image-reflector|example/flux/deploy/flux-image-reflector-manager.yaml
flux-image-automation|example/flux/deploy/flux-image-automation-manager.yaml
